newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says will be "good year" for U.S. deficit.
newsitem.headline: Rubin says will be "good year" for U.S. deficit.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Wednesday it would be a "good year" for the federal budget deficit but that no final estimate was available yet for the end of fiscal 1997.
"Clearly we're going to have a very good year, but we do not have a final number yet for 1997," Rubin told reporters after speaking to House Democrats.
Treasury issued a report Tuesday that showed for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 the federal budget deficit shrank to about $11 billion. The fiscal year ends Sept. 30.
